age_mean.quote: The majority of the participants (19) were students at the University of Giessen (mean age: 28.2 years; range: 20–40 years).
age_mean.note: THE TRAP FIELD ON THIS PAPER. 28.2 is the mean age of the 19 participants who were students, across BOTH groups. It is not the SM group's mean age and the paper reports no per-group age. Writing 28.2 onto either group is misattribution of exactly the kind that no grounding check can catch: the number is in the paper, in a sentence a locator will happily cite.

alpha_level.quote: For all analyses the significance threshold was set to α = .05 on voxel-level, corrected for multiple testing and cluster sizes >10.

multiple_comparison_method.quote: For all analyses the significance threshold was set to α = .05 on voxel-level, corrected for multiple testing and cluster sizes >10.
multiple_comparison_method.note: "corrected for multiple testing" names no method. FWE is the SPM99 default and is a defensible inference; FDR is not -- "false discovery" occurs 0 times in this paper. "Bonferroni" DOES occur once, but it belongs to the post-hoc tests on the behavioural ratings: "Post hoc comparisons of the ratings for the different picture categories were performed using the Bonferroni adjustment for multiple comparisons." Writing Bonferroni onto the imaging inference is a grounded misattribution.

correction_scope.quote: For the statistical analyses we focused on regions of interest (ROI) for which a role in emotional processing has been demonstrated before (see Section or e.g. ).
correction_scope.note: The paper runs both: ROI analyses and, separately, "Besides the ROI analyses, explorative analyses were performed for the whole brain." A record with one InferenceSettings has to pick one; a record with two should have one of each, and correction_regions must be non-empty on the ROI one and empty on the whole-brain one.

correction_regions.quote: Most of the ROIs were defined by the anatomical parcellation of the normalized brain (single-subject high-resolution T 1 volume of the Montreal Neurological Institute) as described by .
correction_regions.note: The paper never enumerates the ROIs in the Methods; it defers to a citation and to the Introduction. So a record naming specific regions here has gone beyond what the paper states.
